entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I have a problem with my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so confused by it all. It's not working, and I don't know what to do.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely help you look into that. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?
Oh, um, I think it's a technical thing? It just won't sync with my phone. I've tried turning things on and off like the instructions said, but it's no good. I think it might just be broken.
I understand. It's certainly frustrating when a new device won't sync properly. It sounds like you believe the item is defective. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the word. Defective. I'm not very good with this stuff, and I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like to return it.
Of course, I can help you with that. Let me just pull up your order information and review our return policy. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I access your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered 21 days ago. Let me check the policy here...

Alright, I've confirmed it. Our policy states a 90-day return window for items in their original condition. Since you're only on day 21, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I was stuck with a broken band.

It's absolutely no problem. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. And since I see you're a VeloFit VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $15 credit to your account for the trouble. You can use that on any future purchase.
Wow, a credit too? That's so nice of you. Thank you, Isaac, you've been a wonderful help!
You're very welcome. We appreciate your loyalty. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
